feeds.title: The Autism Therapy Group Blog
feeds.description: The Autism Therapy Group is dedicated to delivering high-quality, clinically proven services for Autism-affected clients and families. Through tailored ABA therapy, they empower children to achieve independence, recognizing each family's uniqueness. Their latest blog elucidates their application of ABA therapy principles in autism treatment.

feeds.title: Illinois Autism Center Blog
feeds.description: Illinois Autism Center, situated in Chicago, offers top-tier ABA therapy in a safe, enjoyable setting. Committed to ethical care, they aim to foster autonomy and future success for clients. Their team isn't just specialists but empathetic mentors, ensuring each child and family feels deeply supported and valued.

feeds.title: iCan Dream Center Blog
feeds.description: iCan Dream Center, a non-profit in suburban Chicago, tackles the school-to-prison pipeline by offering holistic special education services. Their mission empowers neurodiverse youth with skills and resources to thrive. They provide parent support, training, and resources, combating feelings of frustration and helplessness often associated with caregiving for individuals with disabilities.

feeds.title: Stride Autism Centers Blog
feeds.description: Stride Autism Centers is dedicated to empowering preschool learners with autism and their families. Their world-class clinical team utilizes evidence-based therapy for meaningful outcomes. Committed to excellence, they attract, develop, and retain top clinicians, ensuring the best guidance and treatment for every family impacted by autism.

feeds.title: Easterseals Serving Chicagoland and Rockford Blog
feeds.description: Easterseals Serving Chicagoland and Greater Rockford focuses on Early Learning and Disability support, transforming lives through expert education and community assistance. Their blog narrates stories of those impacted by their services, highlighting the profound impact of their mission on families, children, and staff.

feeds.title: The Autism Helper Blog
feeds.description: The Autism Helper, Inc. empowers Autism support networks with resources and tools for success. Their blog, podcast, and training videos offer accessible strategies. Through CE Courses and live events, they deliver comprehensive training. Their focus on positive behaviour change, high expectations, and data-driven decisions adds value to educators, parents, clinicians, and administrators.

feeds.title: The Place for Children with Autism Blog
feeds.description: The Place for Children with Autism specializes in high-quality ABA therapy for ages 2-6 in a preschool-like setting. Their full-day programs target key areas like communication and socialization. With a client-centred approach, they aim for significant improvements in lives. Established in 2017, they've become a leading ABA provider in Illinois.

feeds.title: Chicago Careless
feeds.description: Michael, a native New Yorker, navigates a cultural shift in Chicago, chronicling his journey in 'CHICAGO CARLESS' since 2005. From urban planning studies in Manhattan to grappling with driving, his writing captures the complexities of identity and adaptation in a new city, where familiar assumptions evolve into newfound understanding.

feeds.title: GBC Autism Services Blog
feeds.description: GBC Autism Services offers ABA-based treatments for children with ASD, providing in-home and clinic-based therapy, Early Intervention services, school consultations, and social skills groups. Their individualized programs aim for transformative impact, fulfilling their mission to empower individuals, families, and communities towards greater independence and fulfilment. This promise drives their commitment to making a difference in the lives they touch.

feeds.title: Steinberg Behavior Solutions Blog
feeds.description: Steinberg Behavior Solutions, a Chicago-based team, merges analytical expertise with compassionate connection. Specializing in in-home and in-school ABA Evaluation and Treatment for Autism, they craft personalized plans for each child's success. Offering BCBA therapy and valuable insights through their blog, they empower families in the Chicago area to support their children's development.

feeds.title: Urban Autism Solutions News
feeds.description: Urban Autism Solutions (UAS) pioneers community integration for young adults with autism, serving over 1,000 individuals since 2012. Their programs, like the Transition Academy and Growing Solutions Farm, focus on life skills, social interaction, and vocational training. UAS envisions a society where all individuals with autism are valued members, fostering opportunities for community engagement and meaningful participation.

feeds.title: Help and Healing Center Blog
feeds.description: The Help and Healing Center offers person-centred psychological testing for adults and children. Specializing in neurodiversity-affirming evaluations, they assess autism, PDA, ADHD, learning disorders, and more. With extensive experience, their providers offer comfort and expertise in working with diverse clients.
